description: This file defines network port handling utilities, including the LocalPort struct, protocol constants, and functions for creating, opening, and managing network ports with support for TCP and UDP protocols, IP addresses, and IP families.

classes.name: LocalPort
classes.description: Represents an IP address, port, protocol, and optional IP family for network port operations.

classes.name: Closeable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be closed, such as open network ports.

classes.name: PortOpener
classes.description: Interface for objects that can open LocalPorts.

classes.name: listenPortOpener
classes.description: Implementation of PortOpener that opens network ports.

methods.name: NewLocalPort
methods.description: Creates a new LocalPort instance, validating protocol and IP family, and IP address.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the LocalPort.

methods.name: OpenLocalPort
methods.description: Opens the specified LocalPort, returning a Closeable object.
